generation_members.surface_form: Approximately 40% of the UK's academic HPC was spent on DFT calculations in a recent year, most of which was AIMD.
GNoME was trained on an in-house database of roughly 80 million DFT calculations.
First published U-MLIPs with broad periodic table applicability came nearly simultaneously in early 2022.
